name: my-tickets
title: My Tickets
description: Linear tickets with their opencode session status; Enter jumps to the session via oc-goto.
author: bogdan_culda

commands.name: my-tickets
commands.title: My Tickets
commands.subtitle: Linear → opencode
commands.description: My open Linear issues (type to search all), Enter jumps to the ticket's opencode session.

preferences.name: linearApiKey
preferences.title: Linear API key
preferences.description: Optional. Defaults to LINEAR_API_KEY from your login shell.

preferences.name: ocGotoPath
preferences.title: oc-goto path
preferences.description: Optional session jumper (opencode + herdr). Leave empty for ~/.local/bin/oc-goto; without it the list is Linear-only.
